stops.note: a royal seal or emblem among the Oghuz Turks, from whom the Seljuks and Ottomans descended
drawn at the head of every imperial decree and stamped on coins, it spelled out the sultan's name and titles
the illuminated tughras of Suleiman the Magnificent became prized in Western museums as masterpieces of calligraphy

current_meaning: the ornate calligraphic monogram of an Ottoman sultan
